definition: Run64 (from Run-63 + ER plant append; storage 13.7GW/21.3GWh in 2025): CC_CHP shape isolation — econ_low back to base 0.96, econ_high 1.12->1.35, peak 2.25->1.55, pct_peaking 8->4. Replaces the econ_high->peak cliff with a continuous gradient so the top of the CHP fleet load-follows in high-load months. All other classes unchanged from Run-61.
